name: Suzhou HYC Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Suzhou HYC Technology Co.,Ltd. provides industrial testing equipment and turnkey solutions for flat panel display, intelligent wearable, semiconductor, and automotive electronics industries in China. The company’s products include LCD/OLED touch senser panel testing equipment, LCD/OLED reliability tester, OLED substrate level touch testing equipment, OLED micro crack AOI equipment, OLED de-mura automatic testing equipment, OLED image defect testing equipment, OLED image chroma defect testing equipment, OLED moudle touch function automatic testing equipment, micro OLED display testing equipment, micro OLED display testing equipment, vehicle LCD display black mura testing equipment, aging chamber, pattern generator, 3D light field camera, color analyzer, and imaging colorimeter. It also provides flat panel display detection, testing, and inspection equipment; Touch detection equipment; semiconductor testing equipment; flat panel display GAMMA and DEMURA automatic testing equipment; battery charging and discharging equipment; micro display detection equipment; smartwatch screen function automated testing equipment; touch screen open circuit / short circuit inspection machine; black spot detection equipment; acoustic testing equipment; wearable device testing equipment; front-end glass particle electrical optical composite inspection equipment; wireless headphones; speaker; LCD array; automatic measuring equipment; glass automatic detection equipment; ATE architecture semiconductor tester; vehicle electronic inspection testing equipment; and car electronics test equipment. Suzhou HYC Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
